title: PROFINET: Add support for PA Profile 4.02
description:
The PROFINET specifications have been enhanced with a profile for process automation devices, released under version 4.02. This profile defines a set of standard submodules providing standardized data. As many things are standardized, it is e.g. now possible to resolve the submodule names without loading a GSD file.

This MR adds the following features to the PROFINET dissector:
- names of PA Profile submodules are resolved without a GSD. If Wireshark finds a matching GSD file for the device, the GSD will still be used. So the existing behavior is not modified.
- IO data of PA Profile submodules is decoded (as value + status)
- standard PA Profile alarms have been added to the list of PROFINET alarm codes (channel error type)
